build: commit b158a49 and later, the local cycle release
note: This list is frozen for the whole panel. A finding that asks for a different specification changes the feature for the NEXT round; it does not change this list inside a round.

features.name: Open the radar and see the state of the week
features.criterion: The first screen states the week, the headline and whether the data is current, without a click.

features.name: Reach the items that the digest names
features.criterion: Every item that the digest discusses can be opened from the digest.

features.name: See the must-read set of the run
features.criterion: The must-read items are marked where the reader meets them, not only in the digest.

features.name: Browse the whole collection
features.criterion: All items are reachable and the count shown matches the collection.

features.name: Filter by theme, status, kind, run and score
features.criterion: A filter narrows the list and the count explains what is shown.

features.name: Search the collection
features.criterion: A search reaches the text a reader would search for, including the abstract and the themes.

features.name: Order the list for the task at hand
features.criterion: At least one order serves a real task (newest, strongest, by run).

features.name: Open one item and read its record
features.criterion: The record holds the why, the caveat, the metadata, the DOI and the source, without leaving the page.

features.name: See the abstract that the why was written from
features.criterion: Where a source carried an abstract, the reader can read it.

features.name: See the provenance of the record
features.criterion: The reader can tell where the metadata came from, who wrote the why and how exact the date is.

features.name: Mark an item keep, maybe or skip
features.criterion: The reader can record a decision and it reaches the data, so the next run can calibrate on it.

features.name: See what the radar learned from the triage
features.criterion: The effect of the reader's decisions on scoring is visible.

features.name: See the coverage of the journal watch
features.criterion: For each watched journal it is clear whether the last run swept it and what it produced.

features.name: See which sources failed
features.criterion: A failed source is named with a short reason, where the reader will meet it.

features.name: See that the data is stale
features.criterion: The age of the data is visible and a silent radar is obvious.

features.name: See the wiki state of an item
features.criterion: For an item the reader can see whether an intake note exists, its name, and whether it was ingested.

features.name: Follow an item into the wiki
features.criterion: The intake note and the wiki page it fed can be reached from the radar record.

features.name: Correct or repeat a wiki note
features.criterion: A note can be rewritten when the score or the why changes.

features.name: Carry thinker candidates into the note
features.criterion: The frontmatter fields the ingest pipeline needs are filled or honestly empty.

features.name: Browse the roots documents
features.criterion: The lineage documents are reachable with their strands, narrative and references.

features.name: Start a roots trace from an item
features.criterion: A reader can ask for the roots of a chosen paper from the interface.

features.name: See the queue of roots drafts
features.criterion: Drafts that wait for a narrative are visible and countable.

features.name: Browse and judge the candidate queue
features.criterion: The candidates from the harvest can be read, filtered and scored inside the radar.

features.name: Act on the health advice
features.criterion: The advice names the next action and the reason, in the order of importance.

features.name: Run and inspect the weekly cycle
features.criterion: The operator can run the cycle, see what it did and read the log of the last run.
